label: Selfies
rule: front-camera and mirror selfies of one person

label: People & family
rule: photos of other people, groups, family, friends, portraits taken by someone else

label: Pets & animals
rule: dogs, cats, any animal is the main subject

label: Food & drinks
rule: meals, snacks, drinks, cafes, the food is the subject

label: Travel & nature
rule: mountains, beaches, landscapes, monuments, trips, sky and sunsets

label: City & nights out
rule: streets, buildings, malls, cars, concerts, events, night city

label: Home & everyday
rule: rooms, desk setups, objects, shopping, products, anything everyday

label: Documents & receipts
rule: photos of paper (IDs, bills, notes, whiteboards) and screenshots of payments, bookings, tickets, orders

label: Memes & saved posts
rule: screenshots of other people's posts, reels, tweets, articles, memes, ideas saved for later

label: Other screenshots
rule: any other screenshot: chats, apps, settings, maps, emails

label: Talking & selfie videos
rule: a person talking to the camera, vlogs, selfie videos

label: Screen recordings
rule: recordings of a phone or computer screen

label: Everyday clips
rule: every other video: friends, family, pets, food, events
